_why: The words of the offline notice, in one place (Legal's RL-121 text, 2026-10-06; Legal may amend them). tools/build-site.mjs renders them as plain static HTML: no script, no external request, no tracking, no description or social meta, noindex. The working title is in the visible heading and the tab title only. Block kinds: h2 (a heading), p (a paragraph), small (a small paragraph), ul (a list of items).
title: Orb Combat EX (working title)

blocks.h2: The playable build is offline for now.

blocks.p: Our own automated check found some scenes that flash more often than the recommended limit of three times a second. We have taken the build down while we fix them. No independent photosensitivity analyser has been run.

blocks.h2: What we are working on for its return

ul: Planned: flashing effects reduced and checked again, a notice before anything plays, and a setting to reduce flashing further.
Planned: a reworked close-range fight: light, medium and heavy attacks on three buttons, a launcher, and energy attacks up close.
Planned: a brawl you can move with the stick, and more control of your fighter in general.
Planned: better support for phones, in landscape.

blocks.small: Orb Combat EX is a one-person project: Orb directs it and builds it with AI tools. AI tools wrote the game's code and drafted its art, animation data, dialogue, UI text and design documents.
This page collects and sends no personal data. It is hosted on GitHub Pages, which keeps its own server logs.
